description: Reusable template for creating new blog post pages with proper Article/BlogPosting schema, SEO optimization, and consistent structure.
usage_instructions: 1. Choose one of the existing blog posts as a starting template
2. Copy the HTML structure and replace content sections
3. Update all schema.org metadata (headline, description, author, dates)
4. Write 1000-1500 word article with proper H2/H3 structure
5. Add relevant internal links to other blog posts and service pages
6. Update featured image URL and all image alt tags
7. Customize related posts section at bottom
8. Add to blog.html grid and update sitemap.xml
